predictions: Hey, hey, strong week last week. I only heard the outcome of one of the G matches second-hand so far (and it sadly went the opposite of my pick, grrr), but even with that outcome, I had my best week of the season so far. 20-4 last week (with one more match dumped to a forfeit), and one of those I got wrong in a tiebreaker again. That strong showing takes me to 72-27 (72.7% correct) for the season, and most of my issues reside in B, C and E divs. So if those divisions could play along, please…

Match of the week: (C Div.) Shooter McGavin @ Off Constantly-Reboot. Shooter has been one of the best stories of the league since week 10 of last season. They were 1-6 in D then, but have gone 10-1 since (with the only loss being a tight one in the D tourney final), and have already picked off three top C competitors. Now here they are against another undefeated team that was next to last in C last season. This just has to be the least foreseeable battle for supremacy in any division, doesn't it? Somebody emerges undefeated alone. I'll take McGavin again, 14-10.

Matches #2 # #3: (A Div.) Lunatic Fringe @ Element XL; The Bullies @ 2 Liver Die with LA. Ok, here we go… The league's clear top four teams for the past several seasons have completed the first month undefeated, and now it's time to duke it out within the group. The talent here is deep, the players are mostly pretty experienced, and anyone here can beat anyone else here. Just like we all like it. While Fringe and Liver have both gotten deeper in the last year (especially Fringe, I think), I still have to stick with the recent leaders. Element, 15-9; and Bullies, 17-7.

Match #4: (G Div.) The Neighborhood Dart Knights @ Dart Vader's. With word of She Said losing this past week, Vader Forced their way to the top of G all alone (and this time not in a narrow escape). The problem is… I think Dart Knights are about to make this race messy. DK, 14-10.

Matches #5 & #6: (D Div.) DD-214 @ Reload; Red-eye Rangers @ Village Idiots. The six-pack of 1-loss D teams from last week spit out a four-pack that are still only 1-loss teams this week. And here they are, all facing each other and further narrowing the leader list. This is likely the most even and exciting pair of intertwined matches this week. I'm thinking DD has a little something going right now, so I'll take 'em, 13-11; and the Rangers and Idiots are going the full distance… RR in 1001.

Match #7: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Why So Serious? The battle for "5th best team in the entire RDL" gets heavily underway starting right here. You can laugh if you want, but these teams could be in the top 10% of all of us... and 90% of you won't be. Darty, 14-10.

Match #8: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Menace 2 Sobriety. These teams have got to be wondering just exactly how we reached this point. Fighting it out to see who is left as the only winless C team? No way they expected this storyline. Sanchez gets their first, 14-10.

Match #9: (E Div.) Runs with Corks @ Death Throw. Yep, these teams are a match or two off the lead at this point. But… they have been ringin up points at roughly the same rate as the lead pair. So, any month-long run could put either on top. Corks eke one, 13-11.

Match #10: (G Div.) Killer Dee's @ Bottoms Up. With word that Dee's pulled the monster upset last week, the G race is now a fiesta of crazy awesome. If the Dart Knights do their job over in match #4, this race is ON. How do I not pick Dee's to build on things? 13-11.

Match #11: (F Div.) Nein Mark @ The Dartifacts. Nein Mark has already seen a lot of near-miss nights and we're only one month in. I think they turn that trend around tonight, and get their first, 15-9.
Match #12: (G Div.) Darts and Crafts @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Well, the league is slowly re-expanding post-pandemic, and we're almost back to an H division. So this one… yeah… Crafts, 13-11.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
